<script>
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const protectedNavLinks = document.getElementById('protectedNavLinks');
            const loggedOutButtons = document.getElementById('loggedOutButtons');
            const loggedInUserBox = document.getElementById('loggedInUserBox');
            const navUserName = document.getElementById('navUserName');
            const navUserInitial = document.getElementById('navUserInitial');

            const rawUser = localStorage.getItem('currentUser');
            const token = localStorage.getItem('userToken');

            if (token && rawUser) {
                try {
                    const user = JSON.parse(rawUser);
                    // Logged IN: Show Protected Links & User Avatar, Hide Login buttons
                    if (protectedNavLinks) protectedNavLinks.classList.remove('hidden');
                    if (loggedOutButtons) loggedOutButtons.classList.add('hidden');
                    if (loggedInUserBox) loggedInUserBox.classList.remove('hidden');

                    if (navUserName) navUserName.textContent = user.name || 'Owner';
                    if (navUserInitial) navUserInitial.textContent = (user.name || 'O').charAt(0).toUpperCase();
                } catch(e) {
                    showLoggedOutState();
                }
            } else {
                showLoggedOutState();
            }

            function showLoggedOutState() {
                if (protectedNavLinks) protectedNavLinks.classList.add('hidden');
                if (loggedOutButtons) loggedOutButtons.classList.remove('hidden');
                if (loggedInUserBox) loggedInUserBox.classList.add('hidden');
            }
        });

        function logoutApp() {
            localStorage.removeItem('userToken');
            localStorage.removeItem('currentUser');
            window.location.reload();
        }

        // Micro-interactions for buttons

                btn.style.transform = 'scale(0.98)';

            btn.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
                btn.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
            });
            btn.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                btn.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
            });
        });
    </script>
